unit_title: Opinion Essays & Trend Description (Writing Task 1 + Task 2 prep)
can_do_statements: Can describe and compare data trends in a line graph or bar chart using accurate comparative language
Can write a structured opinion essay with a clear position, supporting paragraphs, and a conclusion
Can use a range of cohesive devices (however, furthermore, in contrast) without overusing them

sample_items.back: a gradual, consistent rise over time
to level off after a period of change
used to highlight a difference between two things

lessons.sparky_prompt_template: Show the learner a simple bar chart description task. Ask them to describe it verbally in under 2 minutes. Score fluency, coherence, lexical range, and grammatical range against IELTS Speaking band descriptors 5-7. Give one specific, actionable correction, not a wall of feedback.

lessons.honesty_disclaimer: AI-scored practice estimate — not an official IELTS result. Useful for tracking trend, not for visa/university submission.
